key_insight: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks combine inspectable Reynolds-stress closures with separate estimates of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty-aware RANS predictions and transfers learned corrections to unseen wind-farm layouts.
method: Use learnable univariate edge splines to model Reynolds-stress anisotropy.
Place variational posteriors on spline coefficients to quantify uncertainty.
Enforce invariance, symmetry and tracelessness through a tensor basis; softly regularise realisability.
evidence_signal: A controlled regression benchmark favoured spline-coefficient posteriors overall; turbulence evaluations showed calibrated in-distribution uncertainty and transfer to unseen wind-farm layouts.
watch_item: Under geometric extrapolation, epistemic uncertainty rises but still underestimates growing prediction errors, leaving the model overconfident.
paper_title: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for trustworthy Reynolds-stress closures
